meta.titre: Property prices by town - price per m² in France
meta.description: Check property prices per m² for more than 30,000 French towns: median flat and house prices from actual sales (DVF) and ANIL rents.

h1: Property prices in France, town by town
intro: Median prices per m² calculated from sales actually recorded by the French State (DVF database) and ANIL reference rents, for more than 30,000 towns. Pick a town or value your property directly.
parDepartementTexte: Each department lists all of its towns with their median price per m².
